${now} · hack-olive · steg.com.tn

${rows}
Date Avis

Source: steg.com.tn/fr/news · Vérification automatique toutes les 3 heures

`; const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-TN', {timeZone:'Africa/Tunis'}); const sfaxNote = $node['Parse and Deduplicate'].json.sfaxCount > 0 ? ` (dont ${$node['Parse and Deduplicate'].json.sfaxCount} Sfax)` : ''; return [{ json: { subject: `⚡ STEG — ${articles.length} avis de coupure${sfaxNote} — ${today}`, html }}];
